events.text: Laid down by Cockatoo Docks & Engineering Company.

evidence.quote: Wollongong was laid down by Cockatoo Docks & Engineering Company on 29 January 1941

events.text: Launched, sponsored by the wife of Jack Beasley.

evidence.quote: She was launched on 5 July 1941 , by the wife of Jack Beasley

events.text: Commissioned into the Royal Australian Navy.

evidence.quote: was commissioned into the RAN on 23 October 1941
On 11 January 1942 , she was sent to Singapore

events.text: Sailed to Diego Garcia to join the British Eastern Fleet.

events.label: combat
events.text: Shelled beached U-617 and received partial credit for its destruction.

evidence.quote: In September 1943 , while in the Mediterranean , Wollongong was called on to shell the beached German submarine U-617
Wollongong returned to Australian waters in February 1945

events.text: Returned to Australia from the Far East at end of 1945.
